summary.text: Rob Geringer is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 42, serving since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Rob Geringer earned a bachelor's degree in civil engineering from the University of Wyoming in 1995 and a master's degree in engineering from the University of Colorado in 2000.
Geringer's career experience includes working as a business owner, and Geringer has been affiliated with the Cheyenne Housing Authority Board.
Geringer assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 6, 2025, succeeding Ben Hornok.
For 2025-2026, Geringer serves on the Select Committee on School Facilities and the House Transportation, Highways and Military Affairs Committee.
